summary: Iter94 — FINAL PRODUCTION-READINESS AUDIT. RECOMMEND PASS / SAFE TO REDEPLOY. 22/22 backend regression tests pass (test_iter94_audit.py) covering: health, multi-portal login returning all 4 portal tokens (iter87+), /auth/issue-portal-token rehydration (iter88), /pm/me·/hr/me·/shop/me, role isolation (HR-only token correctly 401s against /admin/* and /pm/me), /admin/backups-complete-r2-state, /field-leadership, /job-photos, all 8 form-list endpoints (inspections, meetings, JHAs, trench-boxes, incidents, daily-reports, equipment-inspections, qaqc) with NO Mongo _id leakage, directory CRUD with both show and email delivery (email path correctly falls back to email_sent=false in preview because AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false — expected & spec'd), HR direct login. Frontend critical iter89 multi-portal flow VERIFIED: signed in once at /sign-in as jaymn.judd@mascigc.com → landed on Hub → navigated to /admin, /pm, /hr, /shop sequentially → ZERO re-login prompts, all 4 portal tokens + directory token remained in localStorage throughout. AdminShell + KPI strip render with 8 Safety/Field tiles + 2 Leadership tiles, weekly delta chips (+44 7d on Daily Reports, +11 7d on Pre-Op, +335 7d on Field Leadership), red alert badge '4' on Equipment Pre-Op, SWITCH PORTAL dropdown + 'ALL OK' chip visible. Sign Out button present. Mobile 375x812 viewport: Hub + Cheatsheet + /sign-in all render with no horizontal overflow. Branding: 'Judd Group' = 0 occurrences, 'maintained in-house by MASCI' = 0 occurrences, footer reads 'MASCI OPERATIONS PLATFORM · POWERED BY FORGEDOPS™ · TERMS · PRIVACY · v2026.05.13-d1f3aeb' on Hub. Tab title = 'MASCI Operations Platform'. Zero console errors during nav sweep.
critical_code_review_comments: Multi-portal auth flow (iter87-89) is solid in code AND verified live in browser: /sign-in does NOT clearAllTokens on mount any more, MultiPortalHydrator + usePortalHydration guard race fix work — navigating /sign-in → / → /admin → /pm → /hr → /shop preserves all 5 storage tokens. The user's repeated complaint is conclusively fixed.

Backend role isolation works correctly when tested with a TRULY HR-only account (hrmanager@mascigc.com) — /api/admin/directory + /api/pm/me both return 401/403 with X-HR-Token only. Note for next testing agent: the existing conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token on every requests.Session call, so isolation tests MUST explicitly pass headers={'X-Admin-Token': ''} to test true rejection (already handled in test_iter94_audit.py).

Iter90 directory delivery toggle works as designed: 'show' delivery requires password in payload (400 Bad Request otherwise — clear error message), 'email' delivery in preview env falls back to show-on-screen because AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false (correct behavior; production has the flag on).
All 8 form-list endpoints return JSON without Mongo `_id` leakage when admin token is sent — verified by parametrized test.

Frontend KPI strip (iter91-93) renders correctly with green delta chips and red alert badge — visually confirmed in screenshot. Numbers visible on /admin: 56 Daily Reports, 7 Inspections, 1 Meeting, 4 Incidents, 18 Pre-Op (4 failed → red badge), 0 JHAs, 0 Trench Boxes, 0 QA/QC, 335 Field Leadership, 58 Job Photos.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter94_audit.py -v` → 22/22 pass. Key gotcha: conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token on every requests.Session call — when testing role isolation, explicitly pass `headers={'X-Admin-Token': '', 'X-HR-Token': token}` to make the test meaningful (already done in test_iter94_audit.py role-isolation cases). The multi-portal login flow at /sign-in is now stable per iter89 — clearAllTokens removed from all 5 login pages. Email-delivery in preview falls back to show-on-screen because AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS=false — this is correct and not a bug. R2 backup state endpoint works on preview because S3 creds are real. R2 archive listing may 400 intermittently on preview — flag as INFO not a bug per the audit spec.
